cwe_content.cwe: CWE-770,Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

candidate.Reason: Array dimensions are calculated from user-provided SpEL expressions without validation or limits, allowing attackers to specify extremely large array sizes that consume excessive memory resources
Array size is derived from user input without bounds checking, enabling DoS through memory exhaustion by creating very large arrays
Direct creation of arrays with user-controlled sizes without resource limits or throttling, enabling memory exhaustion attacks
